card.name: Direction words ending in -ward
card.fires_on: The ending 'ward' after a compass direction (westward, eastward), and direction words like upward or downward just before a noun such as movement, titration or force.

modes.label: Compass + ward
modes.description: 'ward' completing west/east in descriptions of movement or migration.
modes.example: a steady west<<ward>> surge of the population

modes.label: Upward/downward
modes.description: The word upward or downward modifying a noun such as titration, force or flick.
modes.example: with<< upward>> titration every few minutes until the desired
